connector.name: Notsy Facturación
connector.registryDescription: Emite CFDIs 4.0 y resuelve claves del SAT para agentes de IA (México), con permisos por API key.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.notsy.com.mx over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the heusai account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
